Meta.title: Taksu Tech: receptionist and education robots
Meta.description: Taksu Tech, part of Ezra Robotics, supplies receptionist robots and service kiosks and designs robot kits for schools, with the software, curriculum, and after-sales service to go with them.

hero.title: Robots for lobbies and classrooms
hero.body: Taksu Tech supplies receptionist robots and service kiosks and designs robot kits for schools. We make the software, the kit electronics, and the teaching materials ourselves.

board.alt: The SMP v1 robot controller board with the ESP32 module, a row of white connectors, and the power regulator
board.caption: The SMP v1 robot controller board, designed in-house.

connectors.name: Module connectors
connectors.role: Sensors and motors plug in without soldering

power.name: Power regulator
power.role: Feeds battery power to the whole board

lines.title: Two product lines
lines.intro: Each line has its own site with product details and demos.
lines.receptionImageAlt: Snow and Timo, Bali edition, in a hotel lobby
lines.educationImageAlt: The SD v1 robot with its OLED face, distance sensor, and yellow wheels

demos.title: Try the products in your browser
demos.intro: The receptionist robot demos and the education simulator open without signing in. The venues in them are examples.

cta.title: Want to see the robots in person?
cta.body: We can visit your office, hotel, or school for a demo.

inHouse.title: What we make ourselves
inHouse.intro: We make these parts ourselves, so the products can be adapted to each place and repaired by our own team.

hardware.title: Electronics and mechanics
hardware.body: Custom PCBs and modular frames for the education kits, and body modifications for the receptionist robots.

software.title: Software
software.body: The kiosk app with voice conversation, queues, and ticket printing, and a robot simulator that runs in the browser.

content.title: Lessons and content
content.body: Meeting-by-meeting curricula, teacher guides, and the robot conversation scripts for each venue.

service.title: Service
service.body: Site surveys, installation, staff and teacher training, servicing, and spare parts.

Services.metaDescription: Custom robots and PCBs, IoT and embedded systems, and web apps and dashboards from the Taksu Tech team.
Services.title: Custom projects and IT help
Services.intro: The two product lines remain our main work. Beyond them, the same team takes on projects close to its skills: robots and PCBs, IoT, and web apps.
Services.otherBody: An office network that keeps dropping, a server, or a misbehaving device: tell us about it. If it is outside our field, we will point you to someone who can help.

cta.title: Have a project in mind?
cta.body: Tell us what you need. We will reply with questions or a first proposal.

Demo.metaDescription: Talk to a receptionist robot, print a visitor pass, build your own kiosk in Studio, or program an education robot in the simulator.
Demo.title: Demos in your browser
Demo.intro: Every demo runs in the browser. The venues in them are examples.
Demo.kioskIntro: The robot touchscreen with voice conversation, queues, the guest book, directions, and ticket printing.
Demo.simIntro: Program SD v1 and SMP v1 with code blocks.
Demo.launcherTitle: Pick a robot and a venue
Demo.launcherBody: Open any robot and venue combination full screen.
Demo.tip: Tip: allow microphone access to talk to the robot, and use a tablet in landscape for the closest feel to the real robot.

About.metaDescription: Taksu Tech is the Ezra Robotics unit for service and education robots: receptionist robots, service kiosks, and robot kits for schools.
About.title: About Taksu Tech
About.parentBody: Ezra Robotics integrates robots for inspection, security, and commercial services in Indonesia.
